descriptions.notStarted: I better stop Juliet before she accidentally poisons Romeo with her toxic cooking skills. I'll need to hurry up and see #bHan the Broker#k so I can buy a recipe for a nice food from him.
descriptions.inProgress: Han the Broker was noticeably complaining, and told me if I wanted his #blunchbox recipe#k, then I'll have to fork over #b20,000 mesos#k. That's really pricey, but he's the only way I can acquire the recipe here in Magatia...
descriptions.completed: I got the recipe from Han the Broker. This recipe also gives me this uneasy feeling. This time, it's not the contents, but the broker himself that worries me...
